segments.name: Aerospace
segments.description: Produces business jets and provides aircraft repair, customer support and custom completion services for business aircraft owners and operators.
segments.evidence: Our Aerospace segment is recognized as a leading producer of business jets and the standard bearer in new technology aircraft, aircraft repair, customer support and custom completion services.

segments.name: Marine Systems
products: maintenance, modernization and lifecycle support services
segments.description: Designs and builds nuclear-powered submarines and surface ships and provides maintenance and lifecycle support for the U.S. Navy and commercial customers.
segments.evidence: Our Marine Systems segment is the leading designer and builder of nuclear-powered submarines and a leader in surface combatant and auxiliary ship design and construction for the U.S. Navy.

segments.name: Combat Systems
segments.description: Provides land combat vehicles, weapon systems and munitions for defense customers.
segments.evidence: We offer a broad portfolio of products and services in business aviation; ship construction and repair; land combat vehicles, weapon systems and munitions; and technology products and services.

segments.name: Technologies
segments.description: Provides technology products and services to defense and government customers.
segments.evidence: Our company consists of 10 business units, which are organized into four operating segments: Aerospace, Marine Systems, Combat Systems and Technologies.

revenueModel.text: Customers, including the U.S. Navy and other government and business aviation clients, pay the company for products such as aircraft and ships and for services under contracts.
revenueModel.evidence: We rely on other companies and our government customers to provide materials, components and subsystems for our products.
